verdict.rationale: Composio ships an official CLI (docs.composio.dev/docs/cli) that gives coding agents and terminals a local tool surface to connect apps, execute tools, inspect schemas, and debug, with agent-specific setup like `composio setup --target auto` for Codex/Claude Code and `composio login --agent` for unattended agent auth — clearly designed for AI-native workflows. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the CLI itself (community evidence only covers unrelated cloud/auth issues, not the CLI).
